No renderer calls it: in-app dictation records in the webview and sends voice_transcribe_blob, and the global path stays closed until the release gates tracked as DESKTOP-SYSTEM-DICTATION-UNWIRED-01 pass. The unused voice store wrappers were removed; cut this command with capture.rs if that plan is dropped.
